source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A role fairly similar to that of a registered nurse, without much of a distinct scope of practice separating the two roles","B":"Administering respiratory treatments, managing ventilator settings, performing pulmonary function testing, and providing patient education","C":"Mainly equipment maintenance tasks, with fairly little direct involvement expected in hands-on client care","D":"Fairly little involvement generally expected during emergency respiratory situations arising on the unit"}}
source_row.rationale: A respiratory therapist's role typically includes administering respiratory treatments (such as nebulizer treatments), managing ventilator settings, performing pulmonary function testing, and providing patient education, a distinct scope of practice with specialized respiratory expertise, including involvement in emergency respiratory situations.
source_row.source_name: AARC — Respiratory Therapist Scope of Practice
